description: List all teams in the workspace with pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of teams to return (default 50).

offset.description: Number of teams to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paginated teams envelope (type, count, total, offset, limit, results); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single team by its id.

team_id.description: The unique id of the team.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the team object; on failure (team not found), output contains an error message.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a users envelope (type, count, results); on failure (team not found), output contains an error message.

description: List issues with optional filters (state, assignee, project, cycle, team, priority, label), sorted by sort order.

state_id.description: Optional workflow state id to filter by.

assignee_id.description: Optional assignee user id to filter by.

project_id.description: Optional project id to filter by.

cycle_id.description: Optional cycle id to filter by.

team_id.description: Optional team id to filter by.

priority.description: Optional priority value to filter by.

offset.description: Number of issues to skip for pagination (default 0).

description: Search issues by matching a query string against title, description, and identifier.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return (default 50).

offset.description: Number of issues to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paginated issues envelope of matches; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single issue by its id.

issue_id.description: The unique id of the issue.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the issue object; on failure (issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new issue for a team with optional metadata; identifier, number and branch name are derived automatically.

teamId.description: The id of the team the issue belongs to.

stateId.description: Optional initial workflow state id (defaults to the team's backlog state).

assigneeId.description: Optional user id to assign the issue to.

projectId.description: Optional project id the issue belongs to.

cycleId.description: Optional cycle id the issue belongs to.

labelIds.description: Optional list of label ids to attach.

description: Update fields of an existing issue by its id; state transitions update startedAt/completedAt/canceledAt and reassignment updates the branch name.

issue_id.description: The unique id of the issue to update.

labelIds.description: Optional new list of label ids.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated issue object; on failure (issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete an issue by its id.

issue_id.description: The unique id of the issue to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms the deletion (deleted flag and issueId); on failure (issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the comments on an issue, ordered by creation time, with pagination.

issue_id.description: The unique id of the issue.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return (default 50).

offset.description: Number of comments to skip for pagination (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a paginated comments envelope; on failure (issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single comment by its id.

comment_id.description: The unique id of the comment.

description: Create a new comment on an issue.

body.description: The text body of the comment.

issueId.description: The id of the issue to comment on.

userId.description: Optional user id of the comment author (defaults to 'user-01').

description: Update the body of an existing comment by its id.

comment_id.description: The unique id of the comment to update.

body.description: The new text body of the comment.

comment_id.description: The unique id of the comment to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms the deletion (deleted flag and commentId); on failure (comment not found), output contains an error message.
